(6) VO: audira_generate_voiceover text = isi audio/vo.txt (scriptPath bisa gagal 'no timed lines'), output project/public/audio/vo.wav + vo-words.json; npm run vo -- public/audio/vo.wav; kunci timeline. (7) Film di project/src/episodes/cat/ pola EP05 (F:/AUDIRA-EPISODES/AUDIRA_SAINS_ANAK_2026/EP05_SISI_BULAN_YANG_SAMA/project/src/episodes/moon: MoonFilm.tsx FilmScene+Karaoke+Hud+AudiraSignature+AudiraOutro, timeline.ts SCENES, scenes.tsx per-scene node+shot). Kucing: salin E:/ASET/ASSET-AUDIRA/downloads/glb/animal/cat-base.glb ke public/models/ep10/cat.glb, load GLTFLoader + SkeletonUtils.clone; tulang: Hips(2)→Spine→Chest→Neck→Head(LeftEar/RightEar/Jaw), Chest→Left/RightFrontUpLeg→Elbow→Leg→Foot, Hips→Tail→TailTip, Hips→Left/RightHindUpLeg→Leg→Hock→Foot; tanpa rotasi default, sumbu badan = +z (kepala +z), tinggi 0.36. Putaran: Hips.rotation.z = roll belakang, Spine.z+Chest.z = selisih roll depan; fase A depan π→π/2 (kaki depan dilipat) belakang π→π+10°, fase B keduanya ke 0. Mode hologram = MeshStandard teal transparan 0.28 + fresnel onBeforeCompile; mode nyata = vertex color + MeshPhysical sheen. Animasi Idle/Walk via AnimationMixer.setTime (deterministik). Furnitur: alcove-bookcase-83894d, lounge-sofa-c34b3e, floor-houseplant-8fad17, area-rug-5c56e2, arc-floor-lamp-fa0b5f (AssetModel). 7 adegan di docs/STORYBOARD.md; Finish CYBER_NEON_VOID exp 1 env 0.55 ao off bg #03141A. Lalu npm run sfx (PYTHONUTF8=1, TARGET_LUFS -27 bila G18c tipis). (8) contact sheet 6–8 frame + audit:visual + draft/THEME_CHECK.md + juri buta (record_score self lalu jury). Lalu handover ke sesi C. ATURAN OTONOM: gerbang tahap 9 sudah pre-approved user 2026-11-25 (batch 10 short otonom); kunci F:/AUDIRA-EPISODES/_render.lock sebelum render final penuh; commit hanya folder EP10; setelah final ubah baris topik 038 di F:/AUDIRA-ALL-SKILL/channel-topics/audira-sains/topics.md jadi '[x] SAINS_ANAK/EP10' dan commit file itu saja.
